character: 36 km. Belle-Epoque thermal spa town. Beautiful architecture, small ski domain.
name: Cauterets
description: 76km of pistes, 18 lifts, in the Gave de Cauterets valley. Belle Époque thermal spa town — grand hotels, casino, and the famous Les Bains du Rocher (naturally warm 34°C pool fed by sulphur springs). The ski area sits above the town at Pont d'Espagne, gateway to the Pyrenees National Park. Known for: thermal spa experience, berlingot sweets, and access to the stunning Pont d'Espagne waterfalls and Lac de Gaube.

suitability.spa_seekers: Best in Pyrenees — Bains du Rocher 34°C
